title: Ferdinand the Catholic to Jerónimo de Vich, Pedrezuela 26 Oct 1515, AHN Estado 8715 N.73 (PARES 12751418)

steps.what: PARES search 'Vich cifrada' listed the ciphered letters of the Vich archive (AHN Estado 8714/8715); N.73 images fetched with the rest.

N.73 transcribed from line strips (124 lines, 3,177 tokens, 197 distinct; n73_transcription.txt) with a frequency count (n73_freq.txt): mostly three-letter code groups (sin 151, sud 97, no 93, zre 89, xed 68) and a smaller set of signs (X 171, TH 170, PHI 163, RH 151).

The 1511-12 nomenclator (vich1511) and the Charles I system of N.74 (1519; sex = papa, mod = tiene, sin = de) compared, and the N.79 'Clave de cifra' table: none fits N.73; no deciphered sibling in its key.

N.73: annealing against the esp318 Spanish 5-gram model with the lowercase groups split into letters, as whole units, and as context breaks around symbol runs (solve73.py, solve73g.py): about -2.7 to -3.5 per character, seeds disagree; no solution.
Split from vich1511 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): N.73 is in a different system from the 1511-12 nomenclator, so it is its own entry.

Brackx (issue #94): joint annealing of a value for each sign (letter or common letter pair) and each code group (word, syllable, letter or unknown) under a Spanish 5-gram plus an encipherment-cost term n log(n/N); fixing signs only where the best runs agreed and contexts confirmed: 23 sign values agree, then all signs fixed (score -3.73 -> -3.37 per token).

Matched control: Lazarillo de Tormes (held out) enciphered the same way at the same size (3,282 tokens, 38 sign types, 158 group types); the same first step gets every sign token right and 35-44% of group tokens.

Code groups read by context in three passes: firm 40 types / 1,005 tokens (76%), tentative 29 / 177, unread 90 / 144; sin split into sin = es and sim = en (6 tokens image-checked), X given r/s/z by the model. Full reading of the 124 lines with sized holes and an English translation; CSP Spain II used as context only (no. 240 refers to this letter of the 26th).

Taken in here: v10_relabel.share on n73_reading.md 0.636 (839 words, 480 holes; tentative values as holes): decoded, not read. docs/_validate.py on the firm values (validation.tsv, tokens as transcribed, es-golden-age): pass.

Terrateig, Politica en Italia del Rey Catolico 1507-1516 (CSIC 1963): vol. I on the Internet Archive (politicaenitalia0001terr, lending only, search needs a login); vol. II, which should print the letters to Vich, not found online (Brackx).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 2814 tokens, 67 types, es-golden-age order 4: reading -2.068 per letter; random keys -4.04 (z 8.8); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.742 (mean -2.76, z 42.5); annealer on the real text -2.036. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.002; polyphony 0.045; 349 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.036

outcome.method_basis: Michael Brackx recovered the sign alphabet ciphertext-only (joint annealing of sign and group values against a Spanish 5-gram, with an encipherment-cost term; no crib) and read 40 code-group types by context (issue #94, Oct 2026). Checked on a matched Lazarillo control, where the same first step gets every sign token right and 35-44% of group tokens, and here by docs/_validate.py (pass). The text is not read: 144 group tokens unread, 192 tentative, and the sin/sim and X splits are model-assigned.
outcome.fraction_read_source: brackx2026/n73_reading.md, research/reading_audit/v10_relabel.share: 839 words, 480 holes and doubtful words (every tentative value counted as a hole): 0.636.

gaps.item: 192 tentative group tokens (29 types: bay = uisorrey, suh = emperador, rie = confederado ...)
gaps.detail: each needs a second context or a crib

gaps.item: sin/sim (151 tokens) and X = r/s/z (171 tokens): split by the language model in context, 6 tokens checked on the image
gaps.detail: PARES serves the record at 1,137-1,147 px; a high-resolution copy from the AHN would settle the minims and the sibilants

outcome.notes: Split 14 Oct 2026 from vich1511. Sign alphabet recovered ciphertext-only by Michael Brackx (issue #94, 23 Oct 2026); the decode is not yet a reading (0.636).

credits.note: sign alphabet recovered ciphertext-only, code groups read by context, reading of all 124 lines with English, token table and scripts (with Claude Code, Claude Opus 5.5)

texts.label: N.73, 26 Oct 1515
texts.summary: Ferdinand to Vich at Rome, 26 Oct 1515 (Brackx's partial decode): he cannot help being displeased that through pride and remissness affairs in Italy are in danger, and more so at the weakness of the Pope, who seems set to come to terms against what the league capitulated; he does not believe it, and Vich is to strengthen the Pope on his behalf.
texts.note: 23 Oct 2026: 0.636 of words read as sense (v10, tentative values as holes); 3.9% of letters on look-alike readings; Brackx's own grading is decoded, not read.

prior.where: Terrateig, Política en Italia del Rey Católico (1963) vol. II may print Ferdinand's letters to Vich from AHN Estado; not seen (vol. I only on the Internet Archive, lending); CSP Spain II no. 240 refers to this letter but gives no text of it
